# BuildEntityOfOpenApiExternalOperation

One definition in a build's result, and what the build did with it.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | [`OpenApiExternalOperation`](open-api-external-operation.md) | The definition, as it is after the build. |
| `mode` | [`BuildEntityMode`](build-entity-mode.md) | What the build did with the definition: created it, updated it or left it unchanged. |
